objective_for_doctor:
Age: 47
Sex: Male
Chief Complaint: I have right side of the chest pain, left side of the chest pain, and been coughing up blood

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
I’ve been having sharp, knife-like chest pain on both sides—right and left—and I’ve also been coughing up blood. I’m very short of breath, with chills and I cough up more colored sputum than usual.
[ASK] Do you have wheezing or shortness of breath?
Yes, I’m short of breath. I don’t know about wheezing—I haven’t noticed it clearly.
[ASK] Do you have a fever (≥38°C) or chills along with your respiratory symptoms?
I don’t know my exact temperature, but I do have chills/shivers along with the cough and breathing problems.
[ASK] Do you have shortness of breath or wheezing (especially if you have COPD/asthma history)?
Yes—shortness of breath is significant. I have asthma history and I’ve needed a bronchodilator before, but I’m not sure about wheezing right now.
[ASK] Do you have a fever (≥38°C) with new/worsening cough and sputum?
I don’t know if I have a fever of 38°C or higher, but I do have chills, and my cough is worse with colored sputum.
